airhockey.name: Freeze
airhockey.desc: Freeze the other paddle for a moment.

airhockey.name: Giant Paddle
airhockey.desc: Your paddle grows huge for 5 seconds.

airhockey.name: Split Puck
airhockey.desc: The puck splits in two. Either one can score.

tanks.name: Bouncing Shot
tanks.desc: For 8 seconds your shells glow and bounce 5 times.

tanks.name: Shield
tanks.desc: A bubble blocks every shell and blast for 3 seconds.

tanks.name: Mine
tanks.desc: Drop a blinking mine behind you. It goes off when a tank rolls over it or a shell hits it.
